Resolves #21371

Related: #20874

Darkens `--neo-board-accent-color` (with `--neo-board-focus-color` and `--neo-board-card-selected-border-color`) in `neo-theme-neo-light` from `#0f9f8f` to `#0a7a6e` so the card editor's Save label (`#f3f5f8`) reaches `4.78:1`, and supplies the missing `neo-theme-cyberpunk` value sheets for `dialog/Base.css`, `form/field/Text.css`, and `form/field/Select.css` so the editor's header icons (`9.61:1`, up from `1.24:1` UA black) and every unfocused field boundary (`3.87:1` against `#161b22`, `4.23:1` against `#0d1117`, up from `0px none`) clear WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 and SC 1.4.11.

Evidence: L3 (live Chromium computed-style WCAG verification + full-viewport before/after captures + `e2e-engine` `BasicNL.spec.mjs`) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-3).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` runs in CI (`restoration` → `fix`).

## Deltas from ticket

- `#21438` (`6802d9feac`) added `resources/css/theme-cyberpunk/dialog/Base.css` with only the two hover tokens; the rest-state `--dialog-*` tokens join that file rather than creating a new one.
- `CardEditor` mounts `Neo.form.field.Select` (`Status`, `Lane`) alongside `TextField` subclasses (`Title`, `Description`, `Assignees`, `Tags`, `Progress`, `Color`, `Due date`), and `resources/css/theme-cyberpunk/form/field/` lacked both `Text.css` and `Select.css` (`border: 0px none` on all 8 controls); both variable-only value sheets are added (`node buildScripts/util/check-theme-value-files.mjs` green).

## Reviews

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-19T23:49:19Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — theme value sheets (variables only, `check-theme-value-files.mjs` green) plus a contrast e2e arm; no architectural concept, and each value answers a WCAG threshold the ticket names.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** #21371 asks for the neo-light Save label at 4.5 : 1 through the board's own accent token, and for cyberpunk header icons and unfocused field outlines at 3 : 1 in their own theme files. At `7250a334b0` the accent moves `#0f9f8f` → `#0a7a6e` (focus and selected-card border with it, so every accent use stays one colour), and I recomputed each figure from the hex values: Save 4.78 : 1 (3.02 before), icons 9.61 : 1, field borders 3.87 : 1 on `#161b22` and 4.23 : 1 on `#0d1117`. The cyberpunk dialog and field sheets are larger than the two values the ticket names, so I looked for scope creep and did not find it: live on `dev`, a cyberpunk viewport resolves `--dialog-icon-color`, `--dialog-border-color`, `--textfield-border-color` and `--textfield-input-height` to nothing, so this theme's dialogs and fields had no tokens at all, and complete sheets are the fix the ticket's "in their own theme files" asks for. The new field font reads `--neo-font-family`, which cyberpunk's `Global.css:9` defines, so the shorthand stays valid; the deleted dialog comment ("no other --dialog-* token is set here") stopped being true with this change. Rendered surface: both themes as whole pairs at 1440 × 900, verdict BETTER — before, the cyberpunk editor's Description, Assignees and Progress fields have no boundary and the header icons read near-black; after, every control is outlined and the header reads in cyan. CI 33 pass, and the e2e arm fails on `dev` with the exact numbers above.

**Findings:** None.

Non-blocking, for my own lane: these sheets now style every cyberpunk dialog and field, the web desktop's included; I re-check the desktop family's cyberpunk dialogs under #21205.
